Class MembershipCard

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.model.MembershipCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MembershipCard extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a membership card for customer loyalty programs. Tracks loyalty points and manages card expiration status. Implements Serializable to support persistence.

  • Constructor Details

    • MembershipCard

      public MembershipCard(String cardNumber, LocalDate expiryDate)
      Constructs a new MembershipCard with the specified card number and expiry date. Automatically generates a unique ID and initializes points to zero.
      Parameters:
      cardNumber - the card number (cannot be null or empty)
      expiryDate - the card expiry date (cannot be null)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if cardNumber is null/empty or expiryDate is null
